title: Xbox Achievement Drought After Install
app: Jellyfin, Emby, Steam, Steam Deck logs, Xbox and Nintendo exports, Tautulli, AntennaPod, RetroArch, and the *arr stack via official APIs, local databases, webhook payloads, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=xbox:activity
| stats max(days_since_install) as days_since_install, max(days_since_last_achievement) as days_since_last_achievement by title
| where days_since_install>30 AND days_since_last_achievement>14
| sort - days_since_last_achievement
description: Uses Xbox achievement exports telemetry to monitor how long installed games have gone without progress moments in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for games that were started but then abandoned, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Xbox achievement exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Title table of days since last achievement.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds how long installed games have gone without progress moments so you can spot games that were started but then abandoned before it becomes annoying.
